title: Introduction of process-responsible care
summary:
In the Heart and Diabetes Center NRW (HDZ NRW), a new nursing structure and process organization will be implemented in various bed-keeping wards. The overall concept includes the introduction of a process-responsible care system in which the process-responsible nurses plan, coordinate and evaluate the activities of the various professional staff and bear the technical case responsibility for a defined number of patients. Some of these tasks are also part of the reserved activities of nurses in Germany.
Nursing specialists who are responsible for the process are employed who have completed a Bachelor degree in nursing or, in context of intensive care, a further training in intensive care and anesthesia. In addition, a completed induction within the included stations and specific professional experience must be available. Specific further training to become a nurse responsible for the process is also possible. Nurses with process responsibility will continue to be active in direct patient care and take on highly complex care situations. Together with the interprofessional staff, the inpatient course of the patient is controlled in a targeted manner.

As a starting point for the project development, an actual analysis should be carried out. After the implementation in nursing practice, further surveys are planned after 6, 12 and at least 24 months for comparison. The aim of the actual analysis is to record the current organizational and communication structure of the project station. The results should be used as a starting point for further project steps.
conditions: Nursing science study as an actual analysis and evaluation after 6 and 12 months after implementation.

interventions.name: Nurses, medical doctors, psychology, physiotherapy, speech therapy, ext. staff, relatives and patients on the project wards. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All employees are included for voluntary participation in the specified recruitment sizes for the survey with the instrument IzEP©, who are located at the project stations or who regularly do their work there (anchoring on the duty roster, consulting activities at external offices). The same applies to participation in the focus group interview (6 people) and the participant observation. 
Further patient and family-related outcomes will be recorded for all patients who stay in the respective unit for three days or longer.
Exclusion criteria:
Anyone who does not meet the inclusion criteria will be excluded.
